question: At the 2025 European Chess Club Cup, which two Indian Grandmasters won two gold medals each?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gukesh Dommaraju and Divya Deshmukh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian Grandmasters Gukesh Dommaraju and Divya Deshmukh clinched two gold medals each at the 2025 European Chess Club Cup, showcasing India’s dominance in international chess tournaments.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gukesh Dommaraju won two gold medals while representing the team Super Chess__.**
 
• **Divya Deshmukh, the Women’s World Cup winner, also secured two gold medals playing for __Cercle d’échecs de Monte-Carlo__ in the women’s team event.**
 
• **India’s Nihal Sarin also claimed an individual gold medal at the same tournament.**
 
• **The 2025 European Chess Club Cup saw Indian players excel in both men’s and women’s competitions, strengthening India’s global chess reputation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gukesh Dommaraju__

 __
 
• Indian Grandmaster and winner of the 2024 Candidates Tournament.
 
• Represented **Team Super Chess** in the European Chess Club Cup.
 
• Ranked among the world’s top young chess players.
 
 
 
• Divya Deshmukh__
 __
 
• Indian Grandmaster and **Women’s World Cup 2024** champion.
 
• Played for **Cercle d’échecs de Monte-Carlo** in the women’s team event.
 
• One of India’s most promising young female chess players.
 
 
 
• Nihal Sarin__
 __
 
• Indian Grandmaster who won an **individual gold medal** at the same event.
 
• Known for his consistent performance in rapid and classical formats.
 
 
 
• European Chess Club Cup__
 
 
• An annual team tournament organised by the **European Chess Union (ECU)**.
 
• Features top club teams from across Europe in both **open and women’s categories**.
 
• India’s rising stars made a strong mark in the 2025 edition.
